overall_safety_summary: The kitchen countertop is mostly clear, but an open cabinet door or drawer below the counter creates a physical obstruction and tripping hazard in the workspace.

hazards.description: A cabinet door or drawer below the counter is left open and protrudes into the standing area.
hazards.explanation: This creates a physical obstacle in a narrow workspace, increasing the risk of painful bumps, bruises, or trips.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Older adults with compromised balance or reduced peripheral vision are highly susceptible to tripping over low-lying obstacles.
hazards.recommended_action: Close all cabinet doors and drawers fully when they are not actively being accessed.

uncertainties: The exact contents of the small package next to the blue-lidded container.
